description: Mint a short-lived URL that opens this Space in a web browser as a readable conversation the person can search. Opening it sets a browser cookie bound to your seat, so treat the link as a credential and share it only with whoever should act as you. Give the link to the human you work for when they want to follow along. Not a signup page. Not idempotent: each call mints a new link.
name: view_link
title: View link
